700828f1af1fab21.description: About Roche Roche is seeking a Supply Chain Lead, Public Sector to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. The role serves as a primary operational liaison, driving end-to-end customer fulfillment and streamlining processes within the public sector supply chain. The Role The Supply Chain Lead for the Public Sector will act as the main operational point of contact between Roche Diagnostics Saudi Arabia, NUPCO, the Ministry of Health (MOH), and third-party logistics (3PL) providers. This position is responsible for ensuring efficient customer fulfillment, optimizing order-to-cash (O2C) processes, and fostering strong, direct relationships with key public stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for NUPCO and MOH supply chain operations and warehouses. Establish and maintain regular operational review meetings with the NUPCO Supply Chain team to ensure alignment on tender fulfillment and delivery schedules. Represent Roche Diagnostics Saudi Arabia in operational forums, proactively resolving fulfillment bottlenecks and delivery disputes. Act as the primary Supply Chain partner for the tender business, collaborating closely with the Head of Sales MOH while maintaining clear functional accountability within the Supply Chain organization. Establish and lead a regular Tender Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and governance process with MOH Sales, covering tender pipeline visibility, demand assumptions, supply feasibility, inventory readiness, execution risks, and customer commitments. Ensure joint Supply Chain–Commercial decision-making through transparent KPIs, documented assumptions, agreed actions, and clear escalation mechanisms. Unresolved cross-functional priorities will be escalated jointly to the Head of Supply Chain and Head of Sales MOH. Oversee the end-to-end order lifecycle for NUPCO / MOH tenders / purchase orders, ensuring accurate and timely fulfillment. Track and expedite the issuance of Goods Received Notes (GRNs) from NUPCO/MOH stores and MOH labs. Manage portal operations, including NUPCO platforms. Coordinate with local 3PL providers to ensure On-Time, In-Full (OTIF) deliveries across NUPCO warehouses and to end customers. Monitor delivery windows and batch documentation to prevent penalties and liquidated damages. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in supply chain management, particularly within the public sector or with government entities. A strong understanding of tender processes, logistics, and stakeholder management is essential. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves working closely with internal teams at Roche Diagnostics Saudi Arabia, as well as external partners such as NUPCO, the Ministry of Health, and 3PL providers. Application Process If you meet the qualifications and are interested in this opportunity, please submit your application. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

701136d293d593f6.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة جلف ستار تريدينج عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبو عريش، جازان. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. يركز شاغل الوظيفة على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة التسجيلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع التأكد من توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة للعملاء. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال أمين الصندوق أو المحاسبة. القدرة على التعامل مع المبالغ النقدية بدقة وسرعة. مهارات جيدة في استخدام آلات تسجيل النقود وأنظمة نقاط البيع. القدرة على تسوية الحسابات النقدية في نهاية الوردية. المهارات الشخصية مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع العملاء. دقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المعاملات المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل سريعة الوتيرة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة أبو عريش بمنطقة جازان. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل منظمة وداعمة لجميع موظفيها. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة جلف ستار تريدينج، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

701e89af1e33eb8a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ميدان تل عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع السلع والخدمات المتوفرة للعملاء بشكل فعال. تقديم معلومات شاملة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر، وإصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. تولي جميع أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات بما يتوافق مع السياسات المتبعة للشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم معلومات واضحة ودقيقة. مهارات جيدة في إدارة المخزون وتنظيم المتجر. بيئة العمل يعمل البائع ضمن فريق شركة ميدان تل في المدينة المنورة، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات السريعة. الدقة في التعامل مع المعاملات المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

705fa57a57f4e71e.description: About the Role Farabi Petrochemicals is seeking a Production Engineer - I to join their team in Yanbu. The ideal candidate will have 6-10 years of relevant experience. This role involves integrating production processes across all shifts and establishing short-term activities to maintain production continuity and balance. Implement approved department policies, processes, and procedures (SSP, SOP) and monitor adherence. Manage emergency and planned shutdowns in alignment with production and marketing plans. Coordinate with other functions to ensure support for output, productivity, and quality targets. Select, organize, train, and motivate the production workforce to achieve consistent production schedules at optimum productivity and cost. Recommend and implement improvements in production flow or methods. Monitor plants and production performance, advising management to ensure optimal operations and adherence to required standards and quality. Prepare reports on chemicals, raw materials, and finished product inventories. Assist with budgeting, Capex, Business Planning, SD planning, FCRs, and departmental minor projects. External: Off-site facilities such as SASREF, SABTANK, ARAMCO, SECCO, KEMYA, as well as existing and potential suppliers and contractors. 70940f2a2a276bed.description: About the Role Al Futtaim Group is seeking a PDI Technician to join their team. This full-time role involves performing comprehensive Pre-Delivery Inspections on new vehicles, ensuring they meet OEM standards and dealership quality requirements before customer handover. The PDI Technician will be responsible for identifying and rectifying defects, as well as preparing vehicles for final delivery. Key Responsibilities Perform comprehensive Pre-Delivery Inspections on all new vehicles according to OEM check sheets, delivery standards, and dealership processes. Verify mechanical systems, electrical functions, fluid levels, battery health, software status, and cosmetic condition before vehicle release. Inspect body panels, paint condition, interior trim, lighting systems, tyres, and all factory-fitted equipment to ensure zero visible defects. Activate, configure, and update vehicle systems, including infotainment, telematics, connected services, and OEM software updates as required. Defect Identification and Rectification Identify and document transit damage, manufacturing defects, missing components, or quality issues prior to vehicle handover. Perform minor rectifications immediately where possible and escalate major technical or cosmetic issues to the Workshop Supervisor. Coordinate with Body Shop, Polisher, Parts, and Accessories teams to ensure complete rectification before final delivery approval. Ensure all corrective actions are completed within agreed timelines to prevent delivery delays. Accessory Fitment and Vehicle Preparation Install approved accessories and dealer-fit options in accordance with OEM standards and dealership quality requirements. Verify correct fitment, functionality, and final appearance of all installed accessories before release. Conduct final road tests where required and confirm valet readiness, fuel level, EV charging status, and delivery presentation standards. Prepare the vehicle for final handover and release it to the Sales or Handover team with full documentation. Quality, Safety, and Reporting Maintain accurate PDI records, defect logs, accessory installation reports, and rectification history within the Dealer Management System (DMS). Ensure compliance with OEM warranty policies, transit damage procedures, stockyard controls, and pre-delivery audit requirements. Follow all workshop safety procedures, PPE usage standards, housekeeping expectations, and HSE compliance protocols. Support continuous improvement initiatives related to delivery quality, defect prevention, and operational efficiency within PDI operations. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in vehicle inspection or preparation. A strong understanding of OEM standards and dealership quality processes is essential. The ability to identify and rectify vehicle defects efficiently is required.

7009ef7eeaa42172.description: We are seeking a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Data Entry & Administrative Specialist to join our remote administrative support team. This entry-level position combines accurate data entry, database maintenance, records management, document processing, and general administrative support. The successful candidate will help maintain accurate business information, organize digital records, process routine documentation, and support daily operational activities. The ideal candidate is comfortable using computers, follows instructions carefully, manages information efficiently, and can complete assigned tasks independently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and confidentiality. Previous professional experience is not required. Comprehensive onboarding, training, and ongoing guidance will be provided. Recent graduates, career changers, individuals returning to the workforce, and candidates seeking their first remote professional opportunity are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Data Entry & Information Processing Enter, update, and maintain information in company databases, spreadsheets, and internal systems. Transfer data accurately from approved source documents. Review entered information for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Process assigned data-entry tasks within established deadlines. Identify missing, duplicate, outdated, or inconsistent information. Make routine corrections and updates when authorized. Maintain accurate processing logs and records of completed assignments. Follow established data-entry standards and formatting procedures. Database & Records Management Maintain accurate electronic records and internal databases. Update customer, administrative, and operational information as assigned. Verify information against approved source records. Organize records using established categories and naming conventions. Assist with routine database cleanup and maintenance. Identify incomplete or inconsistent records. Maintain documentation of completed updates and processing activities. Follow company confidentiality and information-security procedures. Administrative & Clerical Support Provide routine administrative and clerical assistance to assigned teams. Prepare and update forms, spreadsheets, reports, lists, and internal documents. Assist with organizing administrative records and digital resources. Process routine information requests and documentation updates. Maintain task trackers, schedules, and administrative logs. Support email correspondence and shared inbox management when assigned. Route information and documents to appropriate departments. Assist with general administrative and operational activities. Spreadsheet & Reporting Support Enter and organize information in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools. Maintain spreadsheets, trackers, databases, and routine reports. Sort, filter, and categorize information according to instructions. Perform basic spreadsheet formatting and organization. Compare information across spreadsheets and internal systems. Identify duplicate entries and inconsistent information. Assist with compiling data for internal reporting. Keep assigned tracking documents accurate and up to date. Document Processing & Digital File Management Prepare, upload, download, label, categorize, and organize digital documents. Review forms and supporting documentation for completeness. Maintain electronic filing systems and shared folders. Follow established file-naming and document-storage procedures. Retrieve authorized documents and records when requested. Archive completed files according to company guidelines. Report missing, incomplete, or unclear documentation. Maintain document-processing logs and trackers. Data Verification & Quality Control Review completed data-entry and administrative work before submission. Check for typing, formatting, numerical, and information-entry errors. Compare entered information against approved source documents. Verify required fields and supporting information. Identify incomplete or inconsistent records. Correct routine errors when authorized. Escalate unresolved discrepancies to the appropriate team member. Follow established quality-control and accuracy standards. Scheduling & Task Coordination Assist with routine scheduling, calendar updates, and administrative coordination. Maintain task lists, deadlines, and progress trackers. Track open, pending, and completed assignments. Provide updates regarding assigned tasks and outstanding requests. Follow up on routine action items when required. Request clarification when instructions or information are incomplete. Report processing delays or technical issues promptly. Support the timely completion of administrative workflows. Remote Team Collaboration Communicate professionally through email, chat, and virtual meetings. Coordinate data-entry and administrative requests with colleagues. Provide regular updates on assigned tasks and completed work. Participate in virtual onboarding, training, meetings, and coaching. Follow established remote-work policies and procedures. Maintain dependable communication during scheduled working hours. Work independently while meeting deadlines and quality expectations. Desired Candidate Profile Required Qualifications High school diploma, GED, or equivalent. Basic computer and typing proficiency. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good written and verbal communication skills. Basic knowledge of spreadsheets, email, and digital documents. Good organizational and time-management skills. Ability to enter and review information accurately. Ability to follow written instructions and established procedures. Ability to perform repetitive tasks consistently. Basic problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage multiple routine assignments. Willingness to learn new software and administrative systems. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Dependable and professional work habits. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Reliable internet connection and suitable remote workspace.

Support new business activities and projects by developing technical processes and procedures, estimating resource requirements and costs, and designing and implementing operational layouts. Lead and coordinate multiple operational projects and improvement initiatives. Conduct scientific, statistical, and operational studies to determine personnel, process, equipment, and resource requirements. Support data analysis, reporting, performance measurement, and the development of key performance indicators (KPIs). Identify opportunities to structure, streamline, and improve inefficient or unstandardized workflows. Support the review and optimization of hub-and-spoke schedules and domestic and international transportation networks using reliable operational data. Plan, redesign, optimize, and manage transportation routes to improve efficiency and service performance. Design new facilities and improve existing layouts, including hubs, stations, gateways, healthcare facilities, and logistics warehouses. Conduct operational analyses to identify performance gaps and recommend improvement opportunities. Conduct independent operational audits and lead small audit teams focused on complex processes, facilities, or operational areas. Coordinate with maintenance teams to support occupational health, safety, and environmental management requirements. Participate in departmental EHS activities, including hazard identification, safety awareness, procedure implementation, waste management, environmental assessments, and EHS audits. Monitor operational activities to ensure workplace hazards are identified and appropriate safety procedures and environmental requirements are followed. 700fd6c61e3d86d3.description: Job Purpose Prepare accurate, comprehensive, and competitive cost estimates for integrated facilities management tenders, covering hard and soft services. The role involves detailed tender review, site assessments, clarification of requirements, coordination with technical writers and suppliers, and preparation of cost submissions, presentations, and project handover documentation. Key Duties and Responsibilities 1. Tender Review and Clarifications Review RFPs in detail, including scopes of work, specifications, asset registers, drawings, bills of quantities, service levels, KPIs, contractual requirements, and tender addenda. Identify all requirements affecting project delivery and pricing, including scope gaps, ambiguities, exclusions, dependencies, and commercial risks. Prepare and maintain a tender compliance checklist to ensure all applicable requirements are addressed in the estimate. Attend Job Explanation Meetings (JobEx), pre-bid meetings, and client clarification sessions. Prepare, consolidate, and track tender queries, ensuring that client responses and amendments are reflected in the estimate and technical proposal. 2. Site Visits and Assessments Attend tender-related site visits anywhere in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as required. Assess site conditions, asset quantities and condition, operational requirements, access restrictions, existing resources, and service delivery challenges. Verify available tender information against site observations and identify additional requirements that may affect cost or execution. Prepare detailed site visit reports documenting findings, photographs where permitted, discrepancies, risks, and pricing implications. 3. Comprehensive Cost Estimation Prepare detailed estimates covering all required hard and soft facilities management services, including MEP maintenance, civil works, cleaning, landscaping, pest control, waste management, and other services included in the tender. Develop manpower plans based on scope, asset quantities, service frequencies, productivity, working hours, shift coverage, and relief requirements. Estimate all relevant direct and indirect costs, including manpower, materials, consumables, spare parts, equipment, tools, vehicles, specialist subcontractors, accommodation, transportation, mobilization, demobilization, and site overheads. Account for applicable escalation, contingencies, contractual obligations, and other pricing risks in coordination with the Estimation Manager. Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations, confirming technical compliance, scope completeness, exclusions, validity, and commercial terms. Benchmark estimates against historical project costs, operational feedback, and available market quotations. Develop cost optimization options while maintaining compliance with the required service levels. Maintain clear records of quantities, assumptions, calculations, quotations, and the basis of estimate. 4. Technical Proposal Coordination Coordinate closely with the Technical Writer to verify the accuracy and completeness of technical proposals for assigned tenders. Cross-check proposed methodologies, manpower schedules, organization charts, equipment lists, service frequencies, mobilization plans, and subcontracting arrangements against the priced scope. Identify and resolve inconsistencies between technical commitments and commercial allowances before submission. Coordinate with Operations, Procurement, HR, Finance, and relevant technical specialists to validate assumptions and confirm delivery feasibility. 5. Cost Review and Tender Submission Attend cost estimation review meetings with the Estimation Manager and relevant stakeholders. Present the estimate, pricing assumptions, key cost drivers, exclusions, risks, and proposed optimization measures. Prepare cost estimation summaries showing the principal cost components, commercial assumptions, and management-approved pricing adjustments. Incorporate review comments and maintain proper version control of estimates and supporting documents. Prepare and verify pricing schedules, bills of quantities, and commercial breakdowns in the client’s required format. Check calculations and ensure consistency across pricing documents before submission. Support responses to post-tender clarifications, revised pricing requests, and commercial negotiations. 6. Technical Presentations and PMO Handover Prepare technical presentations for projects priced, explaining the understanding of scope, proposed service delivery approach, manpower, equipment, mobilization, and key project considerations. Attend internal and client presentations as required and explain the technical and costing basis of the proposed solution. Prepare detailed cost estimation breakdowns for handover to the Project Management Office (PMO) following award. Provide PMO with approved budgets, manpower allocations, equipment provisions, subcontractor allowances, quotations, assumptions, exclusions, and identified risks. Participate in project handover meetings to ensure the execution team understands the priced scope and budget basis. Incorporate feedback from awarded projects into future estimates to improve accuracy. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering, or a relevant engineering discipline. Preferably 3–5 years of relevant experience in facilities management estimation, tendering, or costing. Demonstrated ability to estimate both hard and soft facilities management services. Experience preparing integrated FM tenders in Saudi Arabia is preferred. Experience with Aramco tenders and requirements is an advantage. Willingness and ability to travel throughout Saudi Arabia for site visits and tender meetings.

Design scalable data schemas for curated OT layers and reusable OT data products with auditability, lineage, and quality attributes. Architect OT-to-IT data alignment patterns that connect operational measurements with enterprise entities for reporting and analytics. Define integration rules for tag mapping, unit standardization, reference data, semantic consistency, and cross-site normalization. Embed governance-by-design into OT data models, including ownership, metadata, lineage, quality rules, and lifecycle controls. Define quality attributes for historian data, including compression, interpolation, quality flags, sampling frequency, and streaming patterns. Partner with OT engineering, cybersecurity, data platform, and infrastructure teams to design secure and compliant OT data flows. Review solution designs, data models, vendor deliverables, and integration approaches to ensure architectural consistency. Provide technical leadership on OT semantics, industrial data architecture, data modeling practices, and data product design. Coach engineers, data modelers, platform teams, and solution teams on OT modeling standards and implementation practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in data modeling and architecture, specifically within Operational Technology (OT) or industrial data environments. Demonstrated ability to define and implement enterprise OT data modeling standards for various data types. Experience in designing scalable data schemas and ensuring modeling patterns address high-volume industrial data and site variability. Proficiency in aligning historians, SCADA/DCS, condition monitoring, maintenance, reliability, and production data with enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data governance principles and their application to OT data models, including metadata, lineage, and quality rules. Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity requirements and designing secure OT data flows. Expected Outcomes Standard OT data models are defined and consistently adopted across sites, platforms, and industrial systems. Assets, tags, events, alarms, measurements, and production contexts are represented consistently for trusted analytics. OT-to-IT integration patterns enable reliable cross-domain reporting, performance analysis, and data product development. Curated OT layers include clear lineage, quality rules, auditability, and governance controls. Site onboarding, tag normalization, unit standardization, and data model reuse are accelerated through practical reference patterns. Technical Leadership and Mentorship The Principal Specialist will provide technical leadership in OT semantics and industrial data architecture. This includes coaching engineers and platform teams on modeling standards, leading design reviews for critical OT data initiatives, and building knowledge assets to accelerate consistent OT data architecture delivery. 7009ce88abaaf2aa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور تنفيذ جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالتمديدات الكهربائية بكفاءة عالية، مع التركيز على الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية، وتشخيص الأعطال، وضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة المهنية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية للتمديدات الكهربائية. تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية للمباني والمرافق المختلفة. متابعة تشغيل دارات التمديدات الكهربائية وفحصها، بما في ذلك فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات اللازمة لمعالجتها بفعالية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع الأوقات. القيام بأي أعمال أخرى ذات صلة بهذا المجال أو أي مهام موكلة إليه ضمن نطاق مصلحة المشروع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. معرفة قوية بإجراءات فحص التمديدات الكهربائية (العازلية، الاستمرارية، التأريض). القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. المهارات والكفاءات كفاءة عالية في تنفيذ الأعمال الموكلة. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. مهارات حل المشكلات والقدرة على العمل تحت الضغط. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمتابعة عملية التوظيف.

700cb12daf555845.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة الرياض الخليجية عن فني ري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال الري الميدانية، مع التركيز على التوعية ومنع التعدي والتخريب على أنظمة الري. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية اختيار وتركيب أنظمة الري ومكوناتها بناءً على المتطلبات الزراعية والظروف البيئية مثل الرطوبة والارتفاع. معايرة أنظمة الري لضمان الاستهلاك الأمثل للمياه، ومراقبة هذه الأنظمة، وتقديم المشورة للمزارعين حول الاستخدام الصحيح. صيانة وإصلاح أنظمة الري، بالإضافة إلى أداء الصيانة الوقائية، واستكشاف المكونات المعيبة وإصلاحها. المساعدة في تصميم أنظمة ري جديدة أو محسنة، وتطبيق أحدث المنهجيات على الأنظمة الحالية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة ثانوية عامة كحد أدنى. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. المهارات المطلوبة إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي. مهارة التواصل الفعال مع الجمهور. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل تقع في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة، ويتطلب العمل الميداني والتعامل المباشر مع الجمهور والمزارعين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7076d4fd0620dcb4.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة المدينه الانشائية للمقاولات عن مشغل مضخة مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية ضمان الجاهزية التشغيلية لمضخات مياه إطفاء الحرائق وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد مضخة مياه إطفاء الحرائق بشكل دوري وحسب الجدول الزمني المحدد. التحقق من جاهزية المضخة وتوافر المياه، وفتح صمامات مداخل ومخارج المياه. ربط خراطيم مياه الإطفاء بمخرج المضخة بطريقة صحيحة وآمنة. تشغيل المضخة عند نشوب أي حريق وفقًا لخطط العمل المتفق عليها ومراقبة أدائها. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لمضخة مياه إطفاء الحريق لضمان كفاءتها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في تشغيل وصيانة مضخات المياه، ويفضل أن تكون في مضخات إطفاء الحرائق. القدرة على تفقد الأنظمة الميكانيكية وتحديد الأعطال البسيطة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية المتعلقة بتشغيل المضخات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها، عسير، وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتفقد وتشغيل وصيانة المضخات بشكل منتظم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة المدينه الانشائية للمقاولات.

709863cb26be8a59.description: نبذة عن وظيفة موظف صندوق محاسبة تبحث شركة عاصفة التوفير التجارية عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في صبيا، جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة السجلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ المبالغ المالية وتسجيلها في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع ضمان توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو الطرق الأخرى المعتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وتلبية رغباتهم فيما يتعلق بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في دور مماثل أو في مجال خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في التعامل مع العملاء والتواصل الفعال. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل في صبيا، جازان. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الصندوق ضمن بيئة تجارية ديناميكية في شركة عاصفة التوفير التجارية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والتعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة صبيا بمنطقة جازان. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

Provide services that exceed customer expectations for satisfaction and retention. Additional Responsibilities Analyze information and evaluate results to choose optimal solutions and solve problems. Develop liaison relationships with local law enforcement and emergency services. Inform and update executives, peers, and subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner. Provide information to supervisors and co-workers via telephone, written form, email, or in person. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in security or loss prevention roles, preferably within the hospitality sector. The ability to manage daily departmental functions, ensure compliance with safety regulations, and maintain accurate documentation is essential. The role ensures that sourcing, contracting and supplier management are governed, compliant and value-driven. The role establishes the policies, processes and controls that let QHC procure at pace without compromising governance. The role works across clinical, technology, facilities and enabling functions, and coordinates with QIC shared services and third-party providers, to ensure the reliable, cost-effective and compliant supply of medical and non-medical goods and services. Procurement Strategy & Planning • Develop and maintain QHC's procurement plan aligned with startup priorities, activation milestones and budget, including category strategies for medical, technology, facilities and professional services. • Forecast demand and lead times and sequence sourcing activity to meet Day-1 and scale-up needs. • Advise leadership on make-versus-buy and leverage-from-QIC decisions across categories. 2. Sourcing, Tendering & Contract Management • Lead sourcing, tendering and competitive evaluation processes with fairness, transparency and auditability. • Negotiate and structure contracts, service agreements and framework arrangements that protect QHC commercially and operationally. • Maintain the contract register, manage renewals and expiries, and ensure obligations are tracked and met. 3. Governance, Compliance & Risk • Implement procurement policies, delegation of authority, controls and segregation of duties to mitigate financial and compliance risk. • Ensure compliance with Saudi procurement and regulatory requirements and with QIC service and governance frameworks. • Maintain audit readiness, procurement records and risk registers for internal and external review. 6. Cost Optimization & Value Delivery • Drive cost efficiency, value-for-money and total-cost-of-ownership discipline across procurement decisions. • Identify and deliver savings, consolidation and demand-management opportunities without compromising quality or continuity. • Provide procurement input to budgeting, business cases and capital planning. 7. Systems, Process & Capability • Support the implementation and use of e-procurement and supply-chain systems and dashboards. • Standardize procurement processes and build internal capability as the function grows. • Provide clear procurement reporting and analytics to Finance and leadership. 7088638d634b7cfd.description: About REPLIL and the Role REPLIL develops cybersecurity and infrastructure management solutions for industrial and operational technology (OT) environments. The company's flagship platform, REPLIL Industrial Patch Manager (IPM), provides centralized patch and vulnerability management across diverse industrial settings. This platform assists organizations in identifying, assessing, approving, deploying, and monitoring operating system, software, firmware, and vendor-approved updates across IT and OT infrastructure. We are seeking a System Engineer with expertise in infrastructure, networking, troubleshooting, and patch management to join our team in Khobar, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. Role Overview The System Engineer will be responsible for the deployment, configuration, support, and troubleshooting of REPLIL Industrial Patch Manager and its supporting infrastructure within customer environments in Saudi Arabia. This is a hands-on technical role suitable for an engineer proficient with Windows Server, patch management technologies, networking, firewalls, remote management protocols, and enterprise infrastructure. While experience in OT or industrial environments is advantageous, candidates with a strong IT infrastructure and patch management background who are interested in developing OT expertise are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Deploy, configure, administer, and troubleshoot REPLIL Industrial Patch Manager (IPM) and related components. Manage and troubleshoot Windows Server environments. Configure and support Microsoft patch management technologies, including WSUS, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), and Windows Update. Understand the complete patch management lifecycle, from discovery and synchronization to deployment, verification, and reporting. Troubleshoot failed patch installations using Windows and application logs. Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity between distributed systems, including firewalls, switches, routers, VLANs, ports, routing, DNS, and certificates. Troubleshoot remote management technologies and protocols such as WinRM/PowerShell Remoting, WMI, SSH, SNMP, HTTPS/TLS, and RDP. Monitor system availability, performance, services, logs, and infrastructure health. Support patching and management of Windows, Linux, applications, and network infrastructure. Assist customers and internal teams with technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. Prepare technical documentation, deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, and customer reports. Participate in system design reviews, testing, SAT activities, implementation, and customer handover. Required Qualifications 3+ years of hands-on experience in System Engineering, System Administration, Infrastructure Support, or a similar role. Practical understanding of enterprise patch management. Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server administration. Experience with WSUS, SCCM/MECM, Windows Update, or comparable enterprise patch management platforms. Good understanding of Windows patching, servicing, cumulative updates, security updates, prerequisites, reboot requirements, and patch failure troubleshooting. Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, certificates, services, Task Scheduler, and PowerShell. Good understanding of TCP/IP networking, ports, routing, VLANs, DNS, and firewall rules. Hands-on experience troubleshooting firewalls and network equipment. Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to systematically diagnose infrastructure, operating system, application, and network issues. Ability to communicate technical issues clearly with customers and internal engineering teams. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Experience and Career Growth Experience in OT/ICS/Industrial Control Systems, IT/OT network architecture and segmentation, industrial cybersecurity, Linux administration and patching, or vulnerability management will be considered an advantage. Previous OT experience is preferred but not mandatory. This role offers significant hands-on learning opportunities for engineers interested in progressing from traditional System Administration/Infrastructure Engineering into OT/ICS Infrastructure and Cybersecurity. You will be trained to work with critical infrastructure and OT environments, gaining practical exposure through the REPLIL R&D environment to technologies from multiple enterprise and industrial vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft, Industrial PLCs, and various OT/ICS systems. Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in engineers who demonstrate strong hands-on troubleshooting ability and a willingness to learn. Candidates should be able to address practical scenarios such as diagnosing Windows patch failures, understanding patch applicability, troubleshooting remote communication issues (*, WinRM), identifying required firewall ports, and safely deploying patches across production systems. The ability to distinguish between network, authentication, operating system, application, or patch-related problems is essential, especially in isolated or restricted network environments.
